Done. Delivered **`todo_ollama-qwen3.8-flash-next-125b-a6b-q4_01.html`** — a single self-contained file (323 lines, inline HTML/CSS/JS, no external dependencies). The embedded script passes a syntax check.

**Features covered:**
- **Add todos** — input + Add button (Enter/submit works too); empty/whitespace input is ignored.
- **Mark complete** — checkbox or click on the text toggles strikethrough styling.
- **Delete** — × button on each todo.
- **Filters** — All / Active / Completed toggle group with active-state highlighting.
- **Persistence** — saved to `localStorage` (`todos.v1`) on every change, safely loaded (with try/catch fallback) on startup.

Extras: "N items left" counter, "Clear completed" button (auto-hidden when nothing is completed), empty-state messages per filter, and responsive card-style UI. Just open the file in a browser.
